question: Build a peer comp table for four analog and mixed-signal semiconductor companies: Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Microchip Technology and NXP Semiconductors. Alignment rule: for each company use its own fiscal quarter that ended between April 1, 2026 and July 31, 2026 (inclusive); do not calendarize or move any company to a different quarter. Each company has exactly one such quarter. For that quarter report, using GAAP figures from the company's SEC filings as of October 3, 2026: (1) revenue in USD millions; (2) year-over-year revenue growth in % versus the same fiscal quarter a year earlier; (3) gross margin in % = gross profit / revenue; (4) operating margin in % = GAAP operating income / revenue. Also state the fiscal quarter label and quarter-end date used for each company.
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.

**Question:** Build a peer comp table for four analog and mixed-signal semiconductor companies: Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Microchip Technology and NXP Semiconductors. Alignment rule: for each company use its own fiscal quarter that ended between April 1, 2026 and July 31, 2026 (inclusive); do not calendarize or move any company to a different quarter. Each company has exactly one such quarter. For that quarter report, using GAAP figures from the company's SEC filings as of October 3, 2026: (1) revenue in USD millions; (2) year-over-year revenue growth in % versus the same fiscal quarter a year earlier; (3) gross margin in % = gross profit / revenue; (4) operating margin in % = GAAP operating income / revenue. Also state the fiscal quarter label and quarter-end date used for each company.
*As of 2026-10-03*

**Interpreted as:** Alignment rule applied per company: the single fiscal quarter whose end date falls in 2026-04-01 to 2026-07-31 is TXN Q2 FY2026 (ends 2026-06-30), ADI Q2 FY2026 (ends 2026-05-02), MCHP Q1 FY2027 (ends 2026-06-30), NXPI Q2 FY2026 (ends 2026-06-28). ADI's Q3 FY2026 (2026-05-03 to 2026-08-01) is excluded because it ends 2026-08-01, after the July 31 cutoff; ADI's Q2 FY2026 is the qualifying quarter. Fiscal labels are each company's own: TXN and NXPI use calendar-year fiscal years; ADI's fiscal year ends in late Oct/early Nov; MCHP's fiscal year ends March 31, so its June-2026 quarter is Q1 FY2027. NXPI's fiscal quarters are 13-week periods ending on a Sunday, so Q2 FY2026 ends 2026-06-28 rather than 2026-06-30; no calendarization applied. All figures taken on a GAAP basis from the 10-Q for the qualifying quarter, which also carries the prior-year comparative quarter used for YoY growth. Gross margin computed as GAAP gross profit (revenue less cost of revenue/products) divided by revenue; operating margin as GAAP operating income divided by revenue, per each company's income statement presentation. Revenue reported in USD millions as presented in the filing.

|---|---|---|---|---|

- Texas Instruments' qualifying quarter is its Q2 FY2026, the quarter ended June 30, 2026, per its 10-Q filed July 24, 2026. [1][2]
- Analog Devices' qualifying quarter is its Q2 FY2026, the quarter ended May 2, 2026, per its 10-Q filed May 20, 2026; ADI has a 52-53 week fiscal year ending on the Saturday closest to the last day in October. [3][4]
- Microchip Technology's qualifying quarter is its Q1 FY2027, the quarter ended June 30, 2026, per its 10-Q filed August 6, 2026; Microchip's fiscal year ends March 31. [5][6]
- NXP Semiconductors' qualifying quarter is its Q2 FY2026, the fiscal quarter ended June 28, 2026, per its 10-Q filed July 28, 2026. [7]
- NXP's Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended June 28, 2026) revenue was $3,496 million, up 19.5% year-on-year, with GAAP gross margin of 57.3% and GAAP operating margin of 30.6%, as disclosed in its quarterly financial highlights. [7]
- Analog Devices' Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended May 2, 2026) GAAP gross margin was disclosed as 67.3%, versus 61.0% in the prior-year quarter ended May 3, 2025. [3]
- Microchip's Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) GAAP gross margin was disclosed as 63.2% of net sales, versus 53.6% in the prior-year quarter. [5]

- NXP Semiconductors' prior-year (Q2 FY2025) revenue in USD millions, to recompute YoY growth from raw figures: The NXPI 10-Q evidence provides only the disclosed 19.5% year-on-year growth rate and current-quarter revenue of $3,496 million; the prior-year comparative revenue figure is not included in the evidence, so growth is reported as disclosed rather than recalculated. [7]
- Analog Devices' GAAP operating margin as a company-disclosed rate: ADI's results-of-operations table discloses revenue, gross margin % and net income, but not a GAAP operating margin rate; the margin is therefore calculated from GAAP operating income and revenue. [3][4]
